name: survarium::game::assign_music_emitter
evidence: Descriptive name: retains the resource in the selected music slot, stops/releases its old proxy, then calls play_music with 2000 ms and looping enabled; loading callback 0x20014bb60 selects slot 2.

name: survarium::game::play_music
evidence: Qualified diagnostic at 0x200956030; six slots; fades other playing proxies out over 2000 ms; selected slot receives duration and looping arguments; out-of-range track stops all slots.

name: survarium::loading_screen::on_music_loaded
evidence: Descriptive name: async callback installed at 0x20011b839 for mode/ui/loading_music; forwards the loaded single-sound resource to game::assign_music_emitter with slot 2.

name: vostok::sound::sound_instance_proxy::fade_out
evidence: Descriptive name: vtable 0x2009d7ae0 slot 4, queues duration and proxy to 0x200623400, which converts milliseconds to samples and enters propagator state 5.

name: survarium::player_input_handler::on_mouse_move
evidence: Descriptive name: slot 2 of player_input_handler's vtable 0x200959838 (RTTI .?AVplayer_input_handler@survarium@@); horizontal = this+86ECh * (aim_sensitivity 0x200AA2020 while action 25h or 26h is held, else hip_sensitivity 0x200AA2024) / 10 (0x2009E6004); vertical = h/w (render window +20Ch / +208h, integers) * horizontal * invert (0x20F43FBB4) / (pi/3) (0x2009E5DA4): 0.26g's formula, the aspect kept; yaw half +86D0h = -x/180*pi*horizontal, pitch half +86D2h = -y/180*pi*vertical (journal_usage 2: table 0x200AB7CC0/0x200AB7CC8).

name: survarium::weapon_core_cook::construct_weapon_parts_hierarchy
evidence: Qualified diagnostic at 0x200996ca0; pushes the implicit "root" slot (0x20097d324) as slots[0], then the weapon's "slots" (0xe0-byte survarium::weapon_slot each, vector at weapon_core+0x17e0/+0x17e8), parsing each with parse_slot 0x200385ce0, then calls override_slots per module.

name: survarium::weapon_core_cook::override_slots
evidence: Qualified diagnostic at 0x200996dd0; for each module attach_params.slots_to_override entry finds the weapon slot by id (find_slot 0x2006cf060, "slot to override %s not found") and re-parses it with parse_slot, the module as owner (slot+0x80) so the locator comes from the module's model (module+0x230).

name: survarium::weapon_core_cook::parse_slot
evidence: Descriptive name: slot+0x80 owner module; reference_slot -> slot+0x90 (find_slot); else locator matrix -> slot+0x98 (0x40 bytes), "bone" -> u16 slot+0xd8, plane_slot -> slot+0x88 = find_slot(weapon, name) (weapon_slot pointer or null).

name: survarium::weapon_core_cook::add_module_slots
evidence: Descriptive name: pushes the module's attach_params.slots_to_add as new weapon_slot entries (is_critical, accept_module, id, name) owned by the module, each parsed by parse_slot 0x200385ce0.

name: survarium::weapon_core::find_slot
evidence: Descriptive name: (weapon, id) linear strcmp over the 0xe0-byte weapon_slot vector at +0x17e0..+0x17e8; returns the slot pointer or null.

name: survarium::weapon_core::get_slot_transform
evidence: Descriptive name: (weapon, out, slot, parent, bones, ...): follows reference_slot (+0x90), composes owner module slot (+0x80), bone (+0xd8) and locator (+0x98); if plane_slot (+0x88) is set, moves only the position along the slot's k axis onto the plane through the plane slot's origin with normal = its k axis (start pos - 2.0*k, t = -dot(p0-q,n)/dot(n,k), applied if t >= 0). Orientation unchanged; no render effect.

name: survarium::weapon::collect_aim_slots
evidence: Descriptive name: looks up slots aim, aim_2..aim_8 (name table 0x200a90020) and pushes the found weapon_slot pointers into weapon+0x43d0/+0x43d8.

name: survarium::weapon::current_aim_slot_index
evidence: Descriptive leaf: returns byte +0x4484 (next) when the aim-switch blend +0x44ec > 0.5, else +0x4483 (current).

name: survarium::weapon::aim_slot_module
evidence: Descriptive leaf: (weapon, index) returns aim_slots[index]->owner module (weapon_slot+0x80).

name: survarium::weapon_module_scope::load_slots_to_hide_while_aiming
evidence: Descriptive name: reads the module's attach_params.slots_to_hide_while_aiming, resolves each with find_slot and stores weapon_slot pointers in this+0x60/+0x68 (deduplicated). Only scopes carry the list in 0.69d0 data; collimators do not.

name: survarium::weapon::is_slot_hidden_while_aiming
evidence: Descriptive name: (weapon, slot) true when the module owning the current aim slot has an aiming object (+0x238) whose slots_to_hide_while_aiming list (+0x60/+0x68) contains slot. Callers hide whole module models (0x2002c48e0 removes them from the scene) or the body.

name: survarium::weapon::update_body_model_visibility
evidence: Descriptive name: first-person and aiming view and is_slot_hidden_while_aiming(weapon, slots[0] = "root") -> render command 0x200605680 on the body model (weapon+0x6498) with mode 2, else adds it to the scene and uses mode 3; whole-model switch, no per-surface hiding.
